battle_start.text: I don't want to hurt you. I want you warm. Both can be true today.
Every winter we argue, more children freeze. Let's not argue.
You've felt the cold. Stand with me, or stand aside.

hit.text: I'm sorry. I'll carry that one too.

miss.text: Still standing. Good. There's still time to listen.

crit.text: One hurt now, ten thousand spared. I've done the sums.

kill.text: Your warmth goes into the flame now. It won't be wasted.

ally_down.text: Kindled, rise. The cold doesn't care if you're tired.

low_hp.text: I've felt worse. I remember being worse.
low_hp.direction: slightly puzzled, as if unsure whose memory it is

low_hp.text: Not yet. They're all counting on me.

victory.text: Rest now. When you wake, it will be warm.
I'll remember you kindly. I remember everyone kindly.

defeat.text: Then who keeps them warm? Tell me that. Who?
I had a plan. I was the only one with a plan.
